title: Fire TV Stick deals UK: today's prices and which stick to buy
seoTitle: Fire TV Stick Deals UK: Prices and Which to Buy
description: Today's UK prices on every Fire TV Stick, from the £17.99 HD to the 4K Max at £46.99, which one suits your TV, and the prices worth paying.
intro:
**The best-value Fire TV Stick right now is the new Fire TV Stick 4K (2026) at £31.99 on Amazon, down from £69.99.** If you want the fastest stick with the strongest Wi-Fi, the Fire TV Stick 4K Max is £46.99, less than half its £99.99 price since Amazon's August price rise.

Amazon's device deals started on 16 November and should run through [Amazon Black Friday Week](/guides/amazon-black-friday-2026-uk/) (19 to 30 November). These prices are already around last year's Black Friday level, so there's little reason to wait. Last checked: 18 November 2026.

body:
## Which Fire TV Stick should you buy?

Amazon now sells six Fire TV streamers, and the names are confusing. Here's the short version, cheapest first.

- **Fire TV Stick HD:** 1080p only. Fine for a small or older TV that isn't 4K. If your TV is 4K, skip it: the 4K Select costs only a few pounds more.
- **Fire TV Stick 4K Select:** the cheapest 4K stick. A good budget pick for a second TV.
- **Fire TV Stick 4K (2026):** the new mid-range stick, and the best value at today's price. It runs Vega OS, Amazon's newer software.
- **Fire TV Stick 4K Plus:** the older 4K stick, renamed. It runs Fire OS, the system most Fire TV owners already know.
- **Fire TV Stick 4K Max:** the fastest stick, with Wi-Fi 6E and the most storage. Menus and apps open quicker, and it copes better with weak Wi-Fi.
- **Fire TV Cube:** a box rather than a stick, with an Ethernet port, hands-free Alexa and an HDMI input. Only worth it if you'll use those.

For most people with a 4K TV, it's the **4K (2026) at £31.99** or, if your Wi-Fi is patchy or you want the snappiest menus, the **4K Max at £46.99**.

## Vega OS or Fire OS: does it matter?

The newest sticks run Vega OS, which Amazon is moving its streamers onto. The big apps (Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, BBC iPlayer, ITVX, YouTube) are available, but the app store is smaller than on Fire OS, and you can't install apps from outside it. If you rely on a less common app, check it's listed before buying, or choose the 4K Plus or 4K Max, which run Fire OS.

## Fire TV Stick prices worth paying

Amazon put the full prices of its Fire TV sticks up in August 2026, so the "was" prices are higher than in past years. Judge deals by the price you pay:

- **Fire TV Stick HD:** under £20 is a good price.
- **Fire TV Stick 4K Select:** about £22 is a good price.
- **Fire TV Stick 4K (2026) or 4K Plus:** £30 to £35 is a good price. Last Black Friday the 4K stick fell to about £25.
- **Fire TV Stick 4K Max:** under £50 is a good price. Its lowest in the past few years was about £45.
- **Fire TV Cube:** under £110 is fair; it has dropped further during past big sales.

## When are Fire TV Sticks cheapest?

Amazon cuts its own devices hardest during Prime Day (July), Prime Big Deal Days (October) and Black Friday. Away from those sales, the sticks often sit at full price for weeks. Today's prices are the Black Friday prices, so if you need one before Christmas, now is a sensible time to buy. Our [Black Friday 2026 live deals page](/guides/black-friday-2026-live-deals-uk/) tracks other offers as they appear, and you'll find every brand guide on the [Black Friday 2026 hub](/black-friday/).

You don't need Prime for most Fire TV deals, but Prime members get some extra offers. If you want Prime Video on your new stick anyway, our [Prime free trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) explains how to time the 30-day trial, or start one at [amazon.co.uk/amazonprime](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime).

If you're buying a new TV too, many budget sets already have Fire TV built in, so you may not need a stick at all: see our [TV Black Friday deals guide](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/).

### Is the Fire TV Stick 4K or 4K Max better?

The 4K Max is faster and has Wi-Fi 6E, which helps if your router is in another room. For a TV near the router, the cheaper 4K stick streams the same 4K picture.

### Do I need a 4K Fire TV Stick for a non-4K TV?

No. On a Full HD TV, the Fire TV Stick HD gives the same picture for less. A 4K stick is only worth it if you plan to move it to a 4K TV later.

### Does a Fire TV Stick need a subscription?

No. The stick itself has no monthly fee, and free apps such as BBC iPlayer, ITVX, Channel 4 and YouTube work without one. Netflix, Disney+ and Prime Video need their own subscriptions.

### Is a Fire TV Stick cheaper at Amazon or elsewhere?

Usually Amazon, as it's Amazon's own product. John Lewis, Currys and Argos often price-match it during sales, so buy wherever is cheapest on the day.

### Will Fire TV Sticks get cheaper on Black Friday itself?

Probably not by much. Amazon's device prices usually settle at the start of the sale and stay put until Cyber Monday (30 November). If a price goes up before then, it's likely to be back at full price after.
